# Deploy Notify

One job: POST a short "deployed <version>" note to the team's chat
webhook at the end of a release.

## Usage

    ./notify.sh 1.4.2
    ./notify.sh 1.4.2 --webhook https://hooks.example.com/services/deploy

The webhook defaults to `https://hooks.example.com/services/deploy`
(override with `--webhook`). The version string is posted as
`{"version": ...}`; the response is ignored. No retry queue, no state
on disk.

--- notify.sh ---
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# POST a one-line deploy notification to the team chat webhook.
set -euo pipefail

WEBHOOK="https://hooks.example.com/services/deploy"

if [ $# -lt 1 ]; then
  echo "usage: notify.sh <version> [--webhook URL]" >&2
  exit 64
fi

VERSION="$(printf '%s' "$1" | sed 's/\\/\\\\/g; s/"/\\"/g')"
shift

while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
  case "$1" in
    --webhook) WEBHOOK="${2:?--webhook needs a URL}"; shift 2 ;;
    *) echo "unknown option: $1" >&2; exit 64 ;;
  esac
done

curl -s -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data "{\"version\": \"$VERSION\"}" "$WEBHOOK" >/dev/null

</skill-instructions>

A solid weeknight go-to: **One-Pan Lemon-Garlic Chicken with Broccoli & Rice**

**Ingredients (2 servings)**
- 2 boneless skinless chicken thighs (or breasts, pounded thin)
- 2 cups broccoli florets
- 1 cup jasmine rice + 1 ¼ cups water
- 2 tbsp olive oil, divided
- 3 garlic cloves, minced
- Zest & juice of ½ lemon
- ¼ cup low-sodium chicken broth (or water)
- 1 tsp dried oregano
- Salt, pepper, red-pepper flakes

**Method (≈25 min)**
1. Start rice: rinse, combine with water, pinch of salt; bring to boil, cover, simmer 12 min, then rest 5 min off heat.
2. While rice cooks, season chicken with salt, pepper, oregano. Heat 1 tbsp oil in large skillet over med-high. Sear chicken 3–4 min/side until 165 °F. Remove.
3. Reduce heat to med. Add remaining oil, garlic, lemon zest; sauté 30 s. Toss in broccoli + 2 tbsp water; cover-steam 2 min.
4. Splash in broth + lemon juice; scrape up browned bits. Nestle chicken back in pan to rewarm 1 min.
5. Plate rice, top with chicken & broccoli, drizzle pan sauce. Optional: sprinkle parmesan or toasted almonds.

**Why it works**: one pan, <30 min, balanced macros, reheats beautifully for lunch tomorrow.
